note: Edmonton seasonal promo calendar — follows the actual Alberta trade cycle, not generic retail months. Interior = winter money; exterior = summer money. Owner edits copy freely; dates are season-anchors, not ad schedules.

seasons.name: Winter Interior Season
seasons.headline: Windows stay shut — interiors are the season
seasons.angle: Fast-curing dry air = great finish. Zero-VOC options for closed houses. Interior repaint slots book out first in January.
seasons.promo_copy: Winter interior repaints book out early — lock your January–February slot now.

seasons.name: Exterior Booking Window
seasons.headline: Book your exterior before the frost is off the ground
seasons.angle: Exterior season starts when overnight lows stop threatening 5°C — quotes done in March paint in May. First-come scheduling for fascia, siding, doors and trim.
seasons.promo_copy: Spring exterior repaint calendar is open — March quotes paint in May.

seasons.name: Exterior Season
seasons.headline: Peak season — the longest daylight stretch of the year
seasons.angle: Full exterior cycles: fascias, soffits, doors, masonry. Deck/fence staining fits here too. Job sites rotate weekly — flexible scheduling matters.
seasons.promo_copy: Exterior season is live — fascia, soffit, siding and doors while the weather holds.

seasons.name: Fall Catch-Up + Winterize
seasons.headline: Last exterior windows + interior shift begins
seasons.angle: Sunny-side exterior work in dry stretches; interior jobs transition as nights cool. Drywall repairs done NOW cure before heating-season shrink sets in.
seasons.promo_copy: October exterior windows are closing — interior slots opening as things cool.
